Thirty days of posts, one sheet, and a Status column that you control.
In this exercise you'll build and approve your first content calendar.
Set up a Marketing project with your brand kit, your offer and a short customer profile.
Ask Claude for four pillars, and keep the three or four that sound like your customers.
Write your rhythm in one line, like LinkedIn on Monday, Wednesday and Friday, plus a blog article on Thursday.
Generate the calendar with ten columns, every row as draft.
Move it into a sheet, then review it in one pass: approve, edit, or delete.
Refill the gaps, and repurpose week one's article into three posts and a newsletter paragraph.
So: how many rows can you honestly approve, and does every claim have a source?
Pause here and build your calendar.
